title: Taxpayer evidence-response assistant
scope: Help a taxpayer understand an RSL evidence request in plain language, match it to documents the taxpayer already supplied, identify what is still missing, and draft a structured response for the taxpayer to review, edit and confirm

acceptance.text: Drafts cite only the taxpayer's own documents, mark missing items as missing, never claim a document exists that does not, and are saved only as drafts until the taxpayer confirms; the request text is treated as untrusted data
With mock models the TAX-102 evidence-request scenario produces the expected matched and missing items; three live runs are recorded with model provenance
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a human-review PR

verification: With mock models the TAX-102 evidence-request scenario produces the expected matched and missing items; three live runs are recorded with model provenance

notes.text: Added 2026-11-05 to record the agreed AI architecture (ADR-031): hosted models through a role router with local/template fallback, and the taxpayer-side assistant.
